presentation.label: TEMPO FOLLOW
presentation.summary: Follow project tempo by changing playback speed.
presentation.overview: Repitch adds a timestretch option for Flex and Static machines. The sample follows project tempo by changing playback speed, so pitch moves with the tempo.
highlights: Available for Flex and Static machines
usage: For a Flex or Static track, open SRC SETUP and choose RPCH in TSTR. Alternatively set the sample attribute to REPITCH and use AUTO on the track.
Playback speed follows project BPM divided by sample BPM. A 120 BPM loop at 90 BPM plays lower and lasts longer.
PTCH is disabled for Repitch, but RATE still applies. Pickup machines are not supported; sample tempo must be 30–300 BPM and playback speed is capped at 2×.

limitations: The README records MKII operation on image OCTABAM81 and emulator checks. MKI, slices and recorder buffers were not measured in that record.

storage.label: Module storage
storage.conditions: ColdFire playback and UI patch. Final image growth is not published for this catalog revision.

processing.label: CPU / DSP load
processing.conditions: Uses tempo-driven playback speed with timestretch off in the voice renderer. No quantitative load comparison has been published.

impact.conditions: Audio modules are rated for an active instance, including expensive modes and changing controls; MIDI/USB features are rated while enabled. More tracks or instances increase demand. Shared runtime reservations and reused stock buffers are not added again per module. These rough source-backed tiers do not establish hardware headroom or qualification.

cpu.rationale: ColdFire updates tempo-driven playback increments and control/UI paths. The renderer runs with timestretch off, avoiding a new grain-processing algorithm. Low describes estimated incremental module work, not the total cost of sample playback.

dsp.rationale: The documented change selects dry/off voice rendering and carries tempo through the playback increment. It adds no separate DSP effect algorithm; existing sample playback still consumes device resources.

memory.rationale: The described contribution is a playback-speed and menu patch, reusing the existing sample renderer and storage. Minimal estimates added module storage; recorder and slice cases are explicitly unmeasured in the source record.

tests.summary: The README records MKII operation on image OCTABAM81 and emulator checks. MKI, slices and recorder buffers were not measured in that record.

access.location: STATIC or FLEX track SRC SETUP: TSTR = RPCH. The sample attribute route also offers TIMESTRETCH = REPITCH.
steps: Select a STATIC or FLEX audio track with its TRACK key. PICKUP does not offer REPITCH.
Hold FUNC and press SRC to open SRC SETUP.
Turn encoder E (TSTR) to RPCH, after OFF, AUTO, NORM and BEAT.
Press SRC to close SETUP. REPITCH disables PTCH; RATE still applies.
For the sample-based route, load and select a sample on the STATIC or FLEX track. Press AED on the MKII panel, then FX1 to open the audio editor ATTR page.
Use UP/DOWN to select TIMESTRETCH. Press RIGHT to step through NORMAL, BEAT and REPITCH; LEFT steps back. Return to the track and set TSTR to AUTO in FUNC + SRC SETUP to use that sample attribute.
